llm_summary: LinkedIn introduced a “Seems like AI slop” button on July 30, letting users flag content that looks like low‑quality AI‑generated material. Within a short period, over a million members have clicked the button, according to Chief Product Officer Hari Srinivasan. The feature is accessed from the three‑dot menu on posts, signaling LinkedIn’s effort to curb AI‑driven spam and misinformation.
